jp: 歌って踊れて楽器も使える中級神。元は幻の鳥に過ぎなかったが、富の女神に音楽センスを高く評価され力を分け与えられた。ノってくるとトランス状態になり性格が変わる。白金ガチョウのモデルとされる。
jp_grezzo: "歌って踊れて楽器も使える中級神。元は幻の鳥に過ぎなかったが、富の女神に音楽センスを高く評価され力を分け与えられた。ノってくるとトランス状態になり性格が変わる。白金ガチョウのモデルとされる。"
en: A mid-level god who can sing dance and use musical instruments. Originally a mere phantom bird she was given a share of power by the goddess of wealth who appreciated her musical sense. When she starts singing she goes into a trance and her personality changes. It is believed to be the model for the white gold goose.
en_grezzo: "A mid-level god who can sing dance and use musical instruments. Originally a mere phantom bird she was given a share of power by the goddess of wealth who appreciated her musical sense. When she starts singing she goes into a trance and her personality changes. It is believed to be the model for the white gold goose."
it: Una divinità di medio rango che sa cantare, ballare e suonare. In origine non era che un uccello fantasma, poi la dea della ricchezza le riconobbe un grande orecchio per la musica e le cedette una parte del proprio potere. Quando si scalda entra in trance e le cambia il carattere. Dicono che su di lei sia modellata l'oca.

jp: 人間を食料にしようとしている異星人。餌にした人間に擬態し、潜伏を行う。高い科学力と魔力を持つが思い込みが激しく、簡単に相手を信用してしまう。口のあたりから伸びている触手部分が弱点。
jp_grezzo: "人間を食料にしようとしている異星人。餌にした人間に擬態し、潜伏を行う。高い科学力と魔力を持つが思い込みが激しく、簡単に相手を信用してしまう。口のあたりから伸びている触手部分が弱点。"
en: The aliens are trying to use humans as food. It mimics the humans it feeds and hides. They have high scientific and magical powers but they are very naive and will easily put their trust in others. The tentacles extending from the mouth are the weak point.
en_grezzo: "The aliens are trying to use humans as food. It mimics the humans it feeds and hides. They have high scientific and magical powers but they are very naive and will easily put their trust in others. The tentacles extending from the mouth are the weak point."
it: Un extraterrestre che vuole servirsi degli uomini come cibo. Si finge l'uomo di cui si è nutrito e resta nascosto. Ha scienza e magia di prim'ordine, ma si fissa con le proprie idee e si fida degli altri con una facilità disarmante. Il punto debole sono i tentacoli che gli spuntano attorno alla bocca.

jp: 強い魔力と知性を持った狐。昔は滅びた村の周囲にひっそりと生息していたが最近は孤独に耐えられず、人間に化けて街に紛れ込み生活している。同じく紛れ込んでいる人狼を邪魔に思っている。
jp_grezzo: "強い魔力と知性を持った狐。昔は滅びた村の周囲にひっそりと生息していたが最近は孤独に耐えられず、人間に化けて街に紛れ込み生活している。同じく紛れ込んでいる人狼を邪魔に思っている。"
en: A fox with strong magic and intelligence. They used to live quietly around a ruined village but these days they can't stand the solitude so they disguise themselves as humans and live among the city. They think that the werewolves who are also among them are in the way.
en_grezzo: "A fox with strong magic and intelligence. They used to live quietly around a ruined village but these days they can't stand the solitude so they disguise themselves as humans and live among the city. They think that the werewolves who are also among them are in the way."
it: Una volpe con un forte potere magico e una bella testa. Un tempo viveva in disparte attorno ai villaggi abbandonati, ma da qualche tempo la solitudine non la regge più: si traveste da uomo e va a vivere confusa fra la gente di città. E i lupi mannari, che stanno lì confusi allo stesso modo, li considera un impiccio.

jp: 深海で眠っていた九頭竜。半覚醒状態で本来の力は出せていないが強力な精神干渉能力と不死性を持つ。その正体は太古に飛来した宇宙生物で、第一期文明の覇権争いにも参加していた。ツァトゥグァとは親戚。
jp_grezzo: "深海で眠っていた九頭竜。半覚醒状態で本来の力は出せていないが強力な精神干渉能力と不死性を持つ。その正体は太古に飛来した宇宙生物で、第一期文明の覇権争いにも参加していた。ツァトゥグァとは親戚。"
en: The nine head dragon was asleep in the deep sea. In his half-awakened state he does not have his original powers but he does have a powerful mental interference ability and immortality. Its true identity is a space creature that flew in from time immemorial and participated in the struggle for supremacy of the first civilization. He is related to Tsathoggua.
en_grezzo: "The nine head dragon was asleep in the deep sea. In his half-awakened state he does not have his original powers but he does have a powerful mental interference ability and immortality. Its true identity is a space creature that flew in from time immemorial and participated in the struggle for supremacy of the first civilization. He is related to Tsathoggua."
it: Il drago a nove teste che dormiva negli abissi. È sveglio soltanto a metà e la sua forza vera non riesce a tirarla fuori, ma ha un fortissimo potere di interferire con la mente, e non muore. In realtà è una creatura venuta dallo spazio in tempi remotissimi, e alla lotta per il dominio della prima civiltà partecipò anche lui. È parente del Tsathoggua.

jp: 頑張り屋さんな掃除ロボ。掃除に熱中するあまり迷子になったり、思い詰めて家出したりすることもあるので飼育環境には注意。動物好きで、猫などをおんぶしようとする習性がある。
jp_grezzo: "頑張り屋さんな掃除ロボ。掃除に熱中するあまり迷子になったり、思い詰めて家出したりすることもあるので飼育環境には注意。動物好きで、猫などをおんぶしようとする習性がある。"
en: A cleaning robot who is a hard worker. They may get lost in the heat of cleaning or run away from home so be careful of the environment in which they are kept. It is a lover of animals and has a habit of trying to carry a cat on its back.
en_grezzo: "A cleaning robot who is a hard worker. They may get lost in the heat of cleaning or run away from home so be careful of the environment in which they are kept. It is a lover of animals and has a habit of trying to carry a cat on its back."
it: Un robot delle pulizie che ce la mette tutta. Capita che si perda perché si è preso troppo dalla faccenda, o che se ne scappi di casa dopo essersi rimuginato addosso qualcosa: attenzione, quindi, a come lo si tiene. Gli animali gli piacciono, e ha il vizio di provare a caricarsi in spalla i gatti.

jp: 運搬作業や簡単な点検を担当する人型マシン。戦闘用ではないが作業用アームで殴られれば一般人は昏倒するだろう。特殊作業機械に対して劣等感を抱いている。
jp_grezzo: "運搬作業や簡単な点検を担当する人型マシン。戦闘用ではないが作業用アームで殴られれば一般人は昏倒するだろう。特殊作業機械に対して劣等感を抱いている。"
en: A humanoid machine that is in charge of carrying out operations and simple inspections. It's not combat-grade but if hit with a working arm a civilian would be knocked out. They feel inadequate to the special work equipment.
en_grezzo: "A humanoid machine that is in charge of carrying out operations and simple inspections. It's not combat-grade but if hit with a working arm a civilian would be knocked out. They feel inadequate to the special work equipment."
it: Una macchina dalla forma umana che si occupa di trasporti e di controlli semplici. Non è fatta per combattere, ma se ti prende con un braccio da lavoro una persona comune resta stesa. Davanti alla macchina da lavoro speciale si sente da meno.

jp: 精密作業や整備改造を担当する人型マシン。戦闘用ではないので本来は装甲はおろか武器も持たないのだが、アンドロイドを羨んで自分自身を改造。簡単な武器なら扱えるようになっている。
jp_grezzo: "精密作業や整備改造を担当する人型マシン。戦闘用ではないので本来は装甲はおろか武器も持たないのだが、アンドロイドを羨んで自分自身を改造。簡単な武器なら扱えるようになっている。"
en: A humanoid machine in charge of precision work and maintenance and modification. It has no armor or weapons because it is not designed for combat but it has modified itself to be the envy of androids. It can handle simple weapons.
en_grezzo: "A humanoid machine in charge of precision work and maintenance and modification. It has no armor or weapons because it is not designed for combat but it has modified itself to be the envy of androids. It can handle simple weapons."
it: Una macchina dalla forma umana che si occupa di lavori di precisione, di manutenzione e di modifiche. Non essendo fatta per combattere non avrebbe né corazza né armi, ma per invidia degli androidi si è modificata da sola, e adesso un'arma semplice sa maneggiarla.

jp: 乗り物を司る中級神。乗り物の進歩に伴って身体を機械化した。神々の大戦時には自ら建造した戦艦を駆り機械の神と共闘した。後にアンドロイドのモデルとなる。
jp_grezzo: "乗り物を司る中級神。乗り物の進歩に伴って身体を機械化した。神々の大戦時には自ら建造した戦艦を駆り機械の神と共闘した。後にアンドロイドのモデルとなる。"
en: An mid-level god who governs the vehicles. The body was mechanized as the vehicle progressed. During the Great War of the Gods he fought alongside the machine gods in battleships he had built himself. It later became a model for the android.
en_grezzo: "An mid-level god who governs the vehicles. The body was mechanized as the vehicle progressed. During the Great War of the Gods he fought alongside the machine gods in battleships he had built himself. It later became a model for the android."
it: La divinità di medio rango che ha in mano i mezzi di trasporto. Via via che i mezzi progredivano si è meccanizzato il corpo. Nella grande guerra fra gli dei combatté al fianco del dio delle macchine, alla guida di navi da battaglia costruite da lui stesso. Più tardi è diventato il modello dell'androide.

jp: 青き戦場の狼。群れを形成し格上の相手でも連携で仕留める。群れから外れた個体は大抵強力な敵との戦闘で深手を負わされ死ぬのだが、稀に単独で多くの敵を次々薙ぎ倒すような活躍を見せるものもいる。
jp_grezzo: "青き戦場の狼。群れを形成し格上の相手でも連携で仕留める。群れから外れた個体は大抵強力な敵との戦闘で深手を負わされ死ぬのだが、稀に単独で多くの敵を次々薙ぎ倒すような活躍を見せるものもいる。"
en: Blue Wolf of the Battlefield. They form a pack and work together to finish off even the best opponents. Individuals who stray from the pack are usually deeply wounded and die in battle with powerful enemies but in rare cases they are able to mow down many enemies one after another on their own.
en_grezzo: "Blue Wolf of the Battlefield. They form a pack and work together to finish off even the best opponents. Individuals who stray from the pack are usually deeply wounded and die in battle with powerful enemies but in rare cases they are able to mow down many enemies one after another on their own."
it: Il lupo azzurro del campo di battaglia. Si muove in branco, e coordinandosi abbatte anche avversari di categoria superiore. Chi resta fuori dal branco di solito si prende ferite gravi contro un nemico forte e ci lascia la pelle, ma qualche raro esemplare finisce per falciare da solo un nemico dopo l'altro.

jp: 市民そっくりに化ける食人オオカミ。こっそり街や村に紛れ込んで夜な夜な市民を襲う。会話や態度も模倣する演技派。普通の人間では判別困難だが、熟練の冒険者となると体捌きや所持品で判別できるようだ。
jp_grezzo: "市民そっくりに化ける食人オオカミ。こっそり街や村に紛れ込んで夜な夜な市民を襲う。会話や態度も模倣する演技派。普通の人間では判別困難だが、熟練の冒険者となると体捌きや所持品で判別できるようだ。"
en: A cannibal wolf that disguises itself as a citizen. They sneak into towns and villages and attack citizens night after night. An actor who also imitates conversation and attitude. It's difficult for normal humans to tell the difference but skilled adventurers seem to be able to tell by their body language and possessions.
en_grezzo: "A cannibal wolf that disguises itself as a citizen. They sneak into towns and villages and attack citizens night after night. An actor who also imitates conversation and attitude. It's difficult for normal humans to tell the difference but skilled adventurers seem to be able to tell by their body language and possessions."
it: Un lupo mangiatore di uomini che si traveste da cittadino qualunque, tale e quale. Si intrufola di nascosto nei paesi e nei villaggi e notte dopo notte assale la gente. È un attore: imita anche il modo di parlare e di stare al mondo. Una persona comune fatica a smascherarlo, ma pare che un avventuriero esperto ci riesca, dal modo di muoversi e da quel che si porta addosso.

jp: 上位の神であったが癒しの女神を守り通すと決め、女神の下に降った。その献身ぶりを認められ防衛者のモデルとなったまではよかったが、過保護ぶりと生真面目さが原因で最近はちょっと鬱陶しく思われている。
jp_grezzo: "上位の神であったが癒しの女神を守り通すと決め、女神の下に降った。その献身ぶりを認められ防衛者のモデルとなったまではよかったが、過保護ぶりと生真面目さが原因で最近はちょっと鬱陶しく思われている。"
en: He was a superior god but he decided to protect the goddess of healing and he was brought under the goddess. He was once a model defender for his dedication but his overprotection and earnestness have made him a bit of a pain in the ass lately.
en_grezzo: "He was a superior god but he decided to protect the goddess of healing and he was brought under the goddess. He was once a model defender for his dedication but his overprotection and earnestness have made him a bit of a pain in the ass lately."
it: Era un dio di rango alto, ma decise di proteggere la dea della guarigione fino in fondo e scese al suo servizio. Gli riconobbero tanta dedizione da farne il modello del difensore, e fin qui tutto bene: adesso però, fra quanto è protettivo e quanto se la prende sul serio, comincia a risultare un po' pesante.

jp: 実戦に投入されることのなかったイェルスード２号機を改修した新型決戦兵器。表向きは性能強化と武装変更ということになっているが、一度没になった合体機構が開発主任の独断で秘密裏に復元されている。
jp_grezzo: "実戦に投入されることのなかったイェルスード２号機を改修した新型決戦兵器。表向きは性能強化と武装変更ということになっているが、一度没になった合体機構が開発主任の独断で秘密裏に復元されている。"
en: A new type of decisive weapon that is a modified version of the Yerleswood prototype which was never used in actual battle. On the surface it's supposed to be a performance enhancement and armament change but the merging mechanism which once disappeared has been restored in secret by the chief developer's discretion.
en_grezzo: "A new type of decisive weapon that is a modified version of the Yerleswood prototype which was never used in actual battle. On the surface it's supposed to be a performance enhancement and armament change but the merging mechanism which once disappeared has been restored in secret by the chief developer's discretion."
it: Un'arma risolutiva di nuovo tipo, ricavata rimettendo mano al secondo prototipo di Yerleswood, che in battaglia non era mai sceso. Ufficialmente si è trattato di potenziare le prestazioni e cambiare l'armamento, ma il meccanismo di fusione, che a suo tempo era stato bocciato, il capo progettista l'ha rimesso dentro di testa sua e di nascosto.

jp: 鬼面を被った謎の忍者。外法で身体を操られており、意識のあるまま戦わされている。分身や身代わりはもちろんのこと、我流の忍術も身に着けており、その身一つで浮遊し、霧を操る。
jp_grezzo: "鬼面を被った謎の忍者。外法で身体を操られており、意識のあるまま戦わされている。分身や身代わりはもちろんのこと、我流の忍術も身に着けており、その身一つで浮遊し、霧を操る。"
en: A mysterious ninja wearing a demon mask. His body is manipulated by the Outer Law and he is forced to fight back while he is conscious. In addition to his alter ego and body-substitution he also wields his own ninjutsu which allows him to levitate and control the fog.
en_grezzo: "A mysterious ninja wearing a demon mask. His body is manipulated by the Outer Law and he is forced to fight back while he is conscious. In addition to his alter ego and body-substitution he also wields his own ninjutsu which allows him to levitate and control the fog."
it: Un ninja misterioso che porta una maschera da demone. Le arti proibite gli manovrano il corpo, e lo costringono a combattere mentre lui è cosciente di tutto. Oltre allo sdoppiamento e al sostituto sa un ninjutsu tutto suo: si solleva da terra con il proprio corpo e comanda la nebbia.

jp: 全てを焼き尽くす最強最後のファントム。格闘戦もお手の物で、その長い腕から繰り出される攻撃は強烈。空間を歪曲させて移動し、獲物を執拗に追いかける。
jp_grezzo: "全てを焼き尽くす最強最後のファントム。格闘戦もお手の物で、その長い腕から繰り出される攻撃は強烈。空間を歪曲させて移動し、獲物を執拗に追いかける。"
en: The strongest final phantom that burns everything down. Its long arms give off a strong attack and it can fight in combat as well. It distorts and moves through space relentlessly chasing its prey.
en_grezzo: "The strongest final phantom that burns everything down. Its long arms give off a strong attack and it can fight in combat as well. It distorts and moves through space relentlessly chasing its prey."
it: L'ultimo e il più forte dei fantasmi, quello che brucia ogni cosa. Anche il corpo a corpo lo maneggia benissimo, e i colpi che tira fuori da quelle braccia lunghe sono violentissimi. Si sposta piegando lo spazio, e la preda la insegue con ostinazione.

jp: 古の神々の争いの中、切り落とされた神の腕。本体と分断されてなお戦意は残っており、敵めがけてすごい勢いで飛んでいく。凄まじい速度で放たれる拳撃を全て躱すのは至難の業だ。
jp_grezzo: "古の神々の争いの中、切り落とされた神の腕。本体と分断されてなお戦意は残っており、敵めがけてすごい勢いで飛んでいく。凄まじい速度で放たれる拳撃を全て躱すのは至難の業だ。"
en: The hand of the god that was cut off in the strife of the old gods. Even though it is separated from the main body it still has the will to fight and it flies at the enemy with great speed. It would be extremely difficult to dodge all the fist blows that were unleashed at great speed.
en_grezzo: "The hand of the god that was cut off in the strife of the old gods. Even though it is separated from the main body it still has the will to fight and it flies at the enemy with great speed. It would be extremely difficult to dodge all the fist blows that were unleashed at great speed."
it: Il braccio di un dio, mozzato durante le contese degli dei antichi. Staccato dal corpo, la voglia di combattere ce l'ha ancora, e si lancia contro il nemico a una velocità impressionante. Schivare tutti i pugni che sferra a quella velocità è un'impresa quasi impossibile.

jp: ヤギという生物の絶滅後、その代用として何度も身代わりにされてきた羊。しかし、抵抗し逃げ出した強者も存在した。彼らは逃げた先で武装し、今日も生き残るために脅威から逃げ続けるのだ。
jp_grezzo: "ヤギという生物の絶滅後、その代用として何度も身代わりにされてきた羊。しかし、抵抗し逃げ出した強者も存在した。彼らは逃げた先で武装し、今日も生き残るために脅威から逃げ続けるのだ。"
en: Since the extinction of the goat creature the sheep have been sacrificed many times as a substitute for it. However there were some strong individuals who resisted and ran away. They took up arms wherever they fled and today they continue to run from threats to survive.
en_grezzo: "Since the extinction of the goat creature the sheep have been sacrificed many times as a substitute for it. However there were some strong individuals who resisted and ran away. They took up arms wherever they fled and today they continue to run from threats to survive."
it: Da quando la capra si è estinta, la pecora è stata sacrificata al posto suo un'infinità di volte. Ci fu però qualche esemplare abbastanza forte da ribellarsi e scappare. Là dove sono fuggiti si sono armati, e ancora oggi continuano a scappare davanti a ogni minaccia, pur di restare vivi.

jp: 原初の神の炎から生まれた伝説の火炎竜。普段は魔力を鎧状にして熱の吸収放出を抑えているが、傷を負うとそれが保てなくなり熱暴走を起こす。鎧が崩壊すると魔力が炎に混ざり、急激に炎の温度が上昇する。
jp_grezzo: "原初の神の炎から生まれた伝説の火炎竜。普段は魔力を鎧状にして熱の吸収放出を抑えているが、傷を負うとそれが保てなくなり熱暴走を起こす。鎧が崩壊すると魔力が炎に混ざり、急激に炎の温度が上昇する。"
en: A legendary flame dragon born from the flames of the primordial god. Normally it uses magical power as an armor to suppress the absorption and release of heat but when it is injured it is unable to hold on and goes into heat rage. As the armor disintegrated the magical power mixed with the flames causing the temperature of the flames to rise rapidly.
en_grezzo: "A legendary flame dragon born from the flames of the primordial god. Normally it uses magical power as an armor to suppress the absorption and release of heat but when it is injured it is unable to hold on and goes into heat rage. As the armor disintegrated the magical power mixed with the flames causing the temperature of the flames to rise rapidly."
it: Il leggendario drago di fuoco nato dalla fiamma del dio primordiale. Di solito tiene il potere magico stretto attorno a sé come una corazza, e così frena l'assorbimento e il rilascio del calore; ma se si ferisce non riesce più a tenerla e il calore gli va fuori controllo. Quando la corazza si sfalda il potere magico si mescola alla fiamma, e la temperatura del fuoco schizza in alto di colpo.

jp: 充分な熱を得られる環境で育った火炎竜。その辺で普通に育った個体とは発する熱が段違いで、黄色い炎を身に纏う。炎周辺が千度前後もある一方で体内温度が４０度もないのは生来の火炎耐性によるものだ。
jp_grezzo: "充分な熱を得られる環境で育った火炎竜。その辺で普通に育った個体とは発する熱が段違いで、黄色い炎を身に纏う。炎周辺が千度前後もある一方で体内温度が４０度もないのは生来の火炎耐性によるものだ。"
en: A flaming dragon that grew up in an environment where it could get enough heat. It emits different heat from the individual that grew up in the area and clad in a yellow flame. The fact that the temperature inside the body is not 40 degrees while the temperature around the flame is around 1000 degrees is due to innate flame tolerance.
en_grezzo: "A flaming dragon that grew up in an environment where it could get enough heat. It emits different heat from the individual that grew up in the area and clad in a yellow flame. The fact that the temperature inside the body is not 40 degrees while the temperature around the flame is around 1000 degrees is due to innate flame tolerance."
it: Un drago di fuoco cresciuto in un posto dove il calore non gli è mai mancato. Quello che emana non ha niente a che vedere col calore di un esemplare cresciuto in un posto qualunque, e la fiamma che lo avvolge è gialla. Che attorno al fuoco ci siano mille gradi e dentro il corpo nemmeno quaranta si deve alla resistenza alle fiamme che ha dalla nascita.

jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。その瞳には人間から吸い取ったマナが無秩序に混ざり込んでおり、まさしく混沌の瞳と言える。
jp_grezzo: "混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。その瞳には人間から吸い取ったマナが無秩序に混ざり込んでおり、まさしく混沌の瞳と言える。"
en: The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. The mana sucked from the human is mixed in with the chaos in the eyes and it can truly be said to be the eyes of chaos.
en_grezzo: "The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. The mana sucked from the human is mixed in with the chaos in the eyes and it can truly be said to be the eyes of chaos."
it: È un figlio del caos che si è preso il corpo di un uomo e per quella via si è evoluto. Negli occhi gli si è mescolato senza ordine il mana succhiato all'uomo: si può ben dire che siano gli occhi del caos.

jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。肉体と共に取り込んだ剣を一時的に魔剣化しており、獲物の血を啜らせる。その太刀筋は滅茶苦茶で、読むことは難しい。
jp_grezzo: "混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。肉体と共に取り込んだ剣を一時的に魔剣化しており、獲物の血を啜らせる。その太刀筋は滅茶苦茶で、読むことは難しい。"
en: The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. The sword he has taken in with his body is temporarily transformed into a magical sword making him shed the blood of his prey. Its boldness is so messed up that it is difficult to read.
en_grezzo: "The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. The sword he has taken in with his body is temporarily transformed into a magical sword making him shed the blood of his prey. Its boldness is so messed up that it is difficult to read."
it: È un figlio del caos che si è preso il corpo di un uomo e per quella via si è evoluto. La spada che si è incamerato insieme al corpo la trasforma per un poco in spada maledetta, e le fa succhiare il sangue della preda. Il modo in cui mena fendenti è scomposto, e prevederlo è difficile.

jp: 混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。肉体と共に取り込んだクロスボウを左腕に融合させている。ハンターとしての狩りのセンスは健在。
jp_grezzo: "混沌より生み出された眷属が人間の身体を奪って進化した姿。肉体と共に取り込んだクロスボウを左腕に融合させている。ハンターとしての狩りのセンスは健在。"
en: The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. He fuses his left arm with a crossbow that he has taken in along with his body. As a hunter his hunting sense is strong.
en_grezzo: "The Military Force created from chaos evolved by taking away human bodies. He fuses his left arm with a crossbow that he has taken in along with his body. As a hunter his hunting sense is strong."
it: È un figlio del caos che si è preso il corpo di un uomo e per quella via si è evoluto. La balestra che si è incamerato insieme al corpo l'ha fusa con il braccio sinistro. Il fiuto per la caccia, da cacciatore qual era, ce l'ha ancora intatto.

jp: その巨体と馬鹿力から銀熊の異名を持つが、幼い頃から体格とやや毛深いことがコンプレックスであり自分の異名を嫌っている。熊呼ばわりされるのが嫌で人の話を聞かない。力だけでなく母性本能も人一倍強い。
jp_grezzo: "その巨体と馬鹿力から銀熊の異名を持つが、幼い頃から体格とやや毛深いことがコンプレックスであり自分の異名を嫌っている。熊呼ばわりされるのが嫌で人の話を聞かない。力だけでなく母性本能も人一倍強い。"
en: She is known as a silver bear because of her huge body and stupendous strength but since she was a child she has had a complex about her physique and hairiness and hates her nickname. She doesn't listen to people because she doesn't like being called a bear. She has not only strength but also a maternal instinct that is much stronger than most people.
en_grezzo: "She is known as a silver bear because of her huge body and stupendous strength but since she was a child she has had a complex about her physique and hairiness and hates her nickname. She doesn't listen to people because she doesn't like being called a bear. She has not only strength but also a maternal instinct that is much stronger than most people."
it: Il soprannome di orsa d'argento le viene dal corpo massiccio e da una forza bestiale, ma fin da piccola la corporatura e i peli un po' troppo folti sono stati il suo cruccio, e quel soprannome lo detesta. Sentirsi chiamare orsa le dà tanto fastidio che non sta a sentire nessuno. E oltre alla forza ha anche un istinto materno che vale per due.

jp: 丘の民の中でも情報通で外との架け橋。今でこそ髭はファッション扱いで言葉遣いも多様だが、彼らが外の世界の情報を流布させなければ、今でも女子供全員髭を生やし老人言葉なのが常識だっただろう。
jp_grezzo: "丘の民の中でも情報通で外との架け橋。今でこそ髭はファッション扱いで言葉遣いも多様だが、彼らが外の世界の情報を流布させなければ、今でも女子供全員髭を生やし老人言葉なのが常識だっただろう。"
en: Even among the hillfolk he is a well-informed person and a bridge to the outside world. Nowadays beards are treated as a fashion and language is diverse but if they hadn't let the outside world influence them it would still be commonplace for all women and children to grow beards and use the old language.
en_grezzo: "Even among the hillfolk he is a well-informed person and a bridge to the outside world. Nowadays beards are treated as a fashion and language is diverse but if they hadn't let the outside world influence them it would still be commonplace for all women and children to grow beards and use the old language."
it: Perfino fra gli abitanti della collina è uno che sa le cose, ed è il ponte verso il fuori. Oggi la barba è diventata una questione di gusto e si parla in tanti modi diversi, ma se non fossero stati loro a far circolare le notizie del mondo di fuori, ancora adesso sarebbe scontato che donne e bambini portassero tutti la barba e parlassero come i vecchi.

jp: 遠い昔に集落を去った丘の民たちの子孫。外の世界に出て何世代も生活してきたためか、本来の丘の民たちよりも開放的で挑戦的な性格をしている。何者かに召喚され、先祖ゆかりの地へたどり着いた。
jp_grezzo: "遠い昔に集落を去った丘の民たちの子孫。外の世界に出て何世代も生活してきたためか、本来の丘の民たちよりも開放的で挑戦的な性格をしている。何者かに召喚され、先祖ゆかりの地へたどり着いた。"
en: The descendants of the hillfolk who left the settlement in the distant past. Perhaps because she has lived in the outside world for generations she has a more open and challenging personality than the original hillfolk. She was summoned by someone and arrived at a place related to her ancestors.
en_grezzo: "The descendants of the hillfolk who left the settlement in the distant past. Perhaps because she has lived in the outside world for generations she has a more open and challenging personality than the original hillfolk. She was summoned by someone and arrived at a place related to her ancestors."
it: Discende dagli abitanti della collina che tanto tempo fa se ne andarono dall'insediamento. Forse perché per generazioni hanno vissuto nel mondo di fuori, ha un carattere più aperto e più pronto a rischiare di quello dei suoi simili rimasti. Qualcuno l'ha evocata, ed è arrivata proprio nella terra dei suoi antenati.

jp: 丘長の孫娘。祖父をあまり快く思っていない。祖父の自伝を読まされたり自慢話を聞かされたりする過程で伝統技法の要点を知った。目利きの才能が祖父以上にあるのだが、それ以前に職人になる気がない。
jp_grezzo: "丘長の孫娘。祖父をあまり快く思っていない。祖父の自伝を読まされたり自慢話を聞かされたりする過程で伝統技法の要点を知った。目利きの才能が祖父以上にあるのだが、それ以前に職人になる気がない。"
en: Granddaughter of the hill chief. She doesn't take much pleasure in her grandfather. In the process of reading her grandfather's autobiography and listening to him brag about it she learned the gist of the traditional technique. She has more talent as a connoisseur than her grandfather but before that she has no desire to become a craftsman.
en_grezzo: "Granddaughter of the hill chief. She doesn't take much pleasure in her grandfather. In the process of reading her grandfather's autobiography and listening to him brag about it she learned the gist of the traditional technique. She has more talent as a connoisseur than her grandfather but before that she has no desire to become a craftsman."
it: È la nipote dell'anziano della collina, e il nonno non le va molto a genio. A furia di farsi leggere la sua autobiografia e di sentirlo vantare, ha imparato il nocciolo delle tecniche tradizionali. Per riconoscere la roba buona ha più talento del nonno, solo che prima ancora non ha nessuna voglia di fare l'artigiana.

jp: 丘の民を仕切る長。昔は集落の中でも一番の名工で多くの弟子がいたが、弟子が自分を超えるのを恐れて難癖をつけ全員破門。職人として生きる自信を奪い、結果として若い民の伝統工芸離れを促進した。
jp_grezzo: "丘の民を仕切る長。昔は集落の中でも一番の名工で多くの弟子がいたが、弟子が自分を超えるのを恐れて難癖をつけ全員破門。職人として生きる自信を奪い、結果として若い民の伝統工芸離れを促進した。"
en: He is the chief in charge of the hill people. In the past he was the best craftsman in the village and had many pupils but all of them were excommunicated because he was afraid that his pupils would surpass him. It deprived them of the confidence to live as artisans and as a result it encouraged the young people to leave traditional crafts.
en_grezzo: "He is the chief in charge of the hill people. In the past he was the best craftsman in the village and had many pupils but all of them were excommunicated because he was afraid that his pupils would surpass him. It deprived them of the confidence to live as artisans and as a result it encouraged the young people to leave traditional crafts."
it: È il capo che tiene in mano gli abitanti della collina. Un tempo era il miglior artigiano dell'insediamento e aveva molti allievi, ma per paura che lo superassero trovò a ognuno un pretesto e li cacciò tutti dalla bottega. Così tolse loro la fiducia di poter campare del mestiere, e alla fine spinse i giovani a lasciar perdere l'artigianato tradizionale.

jp: 丘の近辺で収集してきた物を元に家具やら生活雑貨、家屋を作ったり、畑で作物を育てたりして仲間内で細々と取引している。よそ者が来ると外貨獲得のため嬉々として売りつける。
jp_grezzo: "丘の近辺で収集してきた物を元に家具やら生活雑貨、家屋を作ったり、畑で作物を育てたりして仲間内で細々と取引している。よそ者が来ると外貨獲得のため嬉々として売りつける。"
en: They make furniture household items and houses from the things they've collected near the hill and grow crops in the fields. When strangers arrive they gleefully sell them to get foreign currency.
en_grezzo: "They make furniture household items and houses from the things they've collected near the hill and grow crops in the fields. When strangers arrive they gleefully sell them to get foreign currency."
it: Con quello che raccoglie qui attorno alla collina fabbrica mobili, roba da casa e perfino case, coltiva i campi, e commercia in piccolo con i suoi. Quando arriva qualcuno da fuori, per far entrare valuta straniera gli vende di tutto e con enorme soddisfazione.

jp: まだ子供だが見た目は大人とほとんど変わらない。喋り方もほぼ同じだが丘の民の間では服装や雰囲気で区別できるらしい。職人の厳しさと苦しさを子供ながらに予見しており、その道を選ぼうとはしない。
jp_grezzo: "まだ子供だが見た目は大人とほとんど変わらない。喋り方もほぼ同じだが丘の民の間では服装や雰囲気で区別できるらしい。職人の厳しさと苦しさを子供ながらに予見しており、その道を選ぼうとはしない。"
en: He's still a child but he looks almost the same as an adult. The way they speak is almost the same but among the hillfolk they can be distinguished by their clothes and atmosphere. Even as a child he foresees the harshness and pain of the craftsman and he does not choose to follow that path.
en_grezzo: "He's still a child but he looks almost the same as an adult. The way they speak is almost the same but among the hillfolk they can be distinguished by their clothes and atmosphere. Even as a child he foresees the harshness and pain of the craftsman and he does not choose to follow that path."
it: È ancora un bambino, ma a vederlo non è quasi distinguibile da un adulto. Anche il modo di parlare è pressoché lo stesso, però pare che fra gli abitanti della collina si riconoscano dai vestiti e dall'aria che hanno. Bambino com'è, ha già capito quanto sia duro e amaro il mestiere dell'artigiano, e quella strada non la vuole prendere.

jp: 丘の近辺を生活圏とし、遠出することはあまりない。先祖代々、家や採取場、道具などを受け継いでおり、土地に愛着がある。客としてのよそ者には友好的だが、よそ者の移住は認めようとしない。
jp_grezzo: "丘の近辺を生活圏とし、遠出することはあまりない。先祖代々、家や採取場、道具などを受け継いでおり、土地に愛着がある。客としてのよそ者には友好的だが、よそ者の移住は認めようとしない。"
en: They live near the hills and don't travel very far. They have inherited their homes quarries and tools from their ancestors and are attached to the land. They are friendly to strangers as guests but are reluctant to allow strangers to settle in.
en_grezzo: "They live near the hills and don't travel very far. They have inherited their homes quarries and tools from their ancestors and are attached to the land. They are friendly to strangers as guests but are reluctant to allow strangers to settle in."
it: Vive nei dintorni della collina e non si allontana quasi mai. La casa, i luoghi di raccolta e gli attrezzi li ha ereditati di padre in figlio, e alla sua terra è affezionato. Con chi viene da fuori in visita è cordiale, ma che uno di fuori venga ad abitare qui non lo accetta.

jp: 戦闘用に品種改良され金色のオーラを纏うようになったキウイ。品種改良の影響で肉が甘く、黄色くなっている。その神々しさから少数の人々に崇められている。
jp_grezzo: "戦闘用に品種改良され金色のオーラを纏うようになったキウイ。品種改良の影響で肉が甘く、黄色くなっている。その神々しさから少数の人々に崇められている。"
en: A kiwi that has been bred for combat use and has come to wear a golden aura. Due to the breeding process the flesh is sweeter and more yellow. It is revered by a small number of people because of its godliness.
en_grezzo: "A kiwi that has been bred for combat use and has come to wear a golden aura. Due to the breeding process the flesh is sweeter and more yellow. It is revered by a small number of people because of its godliness."
it: Un kiwi selezionato per il combattimento, che a furia di incroci ha finito per portarsi addosso un'aura dorata. Per via della selezione ha la carne più dolce e più gialla. Ha un che di divino, e c'è un pugno di gente che lo venera.

jp: 飛べない鳥。好奇心から他の動物に近づいていくほど警戒心が薄いが、脚力はものすごい。キーウイー、という珍しい鳴き声のせいであまりに安直な名前をつけられた。
jp_grezzo: "飛べない鳥。好奇心から他の動物に近づいていくほど警戒心が薄いが、脚力はものすごい。キーウイー、という珍しい鳴き声のせいであまりに安直な名前をつけられた。"
en: A bird that can't fly. The closer they get to other animals out of curiosity the less alert they are but they have tremendous leg power. It was given an overly cheesy name because of its unusual cry of kee-wee.
en_grezzo: "A bird that can't fly. The closer they get to other animals out of curiosity the less alert they are but they have tremendous leg power. It was given an overly cheesy name because of its unusual cry of kee-wee."
it: Un uccello che non vola. È così poco diffidente da avvicinarsi agli altri animali per pura curiosità, ma di zampe ne ha da vendere. Il verso che fa è curioso, un kii-wii, e per quello gli hanno appioppato un nome fin troppo comodo.

jp: 通称、死を告げる凶星。身体こそ小さいが生き抜こうとする強い意志を持ち、肉体の限界を突破するたびに生命の炎は輝きを増していく。
jp_grezzo: "通称、死を告げる凶星。身体こそ小さいが生き抜こうとする強い意志を持ち、肉体の限界を突破するたびに生命の炎は輝きを増していく。"
en: Also known as the Death Star. Although his body is small he has a strong will to survive and every time he breaks through the limits of his body the flame of life becomes more brilliant.
en_grezzo: "Also known as the Death Star. Although his body is small he has a strong will to survive and every time he breaks through the limits of his body the flame of life becomes more brilliant."
it: Lo chiamano l'astro funesto, quello che annuncia la morte. Il corpo ce l'ha piccolo, ma la volontà di sopravvivere è ferrea, e ogni volta che sfonda i limiti del proprio fisico la fiamma della sua vita brilla di più.

jp: 森にすむ小動物で、樹上からの射撃を得意とする。放たれる矢はまるで流れ星のよう。矢が着弾するまでに願い事をすると叶うとか叶わないとか。
jp_grezzo: "森にすむ小動物で、樹上からの射撃を得意とする。放たれる矢はまるで流れ星のよう。矢が着弾するまでに願い事をすると叶うとか叶わないとか。"
en: He is a small animal that lives in the forest and is an expert at shooting from the tree tops. The arrow is like a shooting star. They say that if you make a wish before the arrow lands it will come true ... or not.
en_grezzo: "He is a small animal that lives in the forest and is an expert at shooting from the tree tops. The arrow is like a shooting star. They say that if you make a wish before the arrow lands it will come true ... or not."
it: Un animaletto che vive nel bosco, ed è bravissimo a tirare dall'alto degli alberi. La freccia che parte sembra proprio una stella cadente. C'è chi dice che se esprimi un desiderio prima che tocchi terra si avvera, e chi dice di no.

jp: 大きな頬袋を持つネズミ。丸っこくて愛らしい姿が人気だが、猫に対する恐怖を乗り越えるため武装しており、戦闘力が普通のネズミと段違い。口内に暗器を隠し持っていることがある。
jp_grezzo: "大きな頬袋を持つネズミ。丸っこくて愛らしい姿が人気だが、猫に対する恐怖を乗り越えるため武装しており、戦闘力が普通のネズミと段違い。口内に暗器を隠し持っていることがある。"
en: A mouse with a large cheek pouch. They are popular for their round adorable appearance and are armored to overcome their fear of cats so their fighting power is unmatched by ordinary rats. They sometimes carry a dark device in their mouths.
en_grezzo: "A mouse with a large cheek pouch. They are popular for their round adorable appearance and are armored to overcome their fear of cats so their fighting power is unmatched by ordinary rats. They sometimes carry a dark device in their mouths."
it: Un topo con due grosse tasche nelle guance. Quel suo aspetto tondo e tenero piace a tutti, ma per vincere la paura dei gatti si è armato, e quanto a forza in combattimento un topo comune non gli sta nemmeno vicino. A volte si tiene nascosta in bocca un'arma occulta.

jp: 宇宙からやってきた作業用の機械生命体。起動時期こそ最近だが、製造された時期は遥か昔のようだ。一度廃棄されており、廃棄区画から抜け出すのには数年を要した。
jp_grezzo: "宇宙からやってきた作業用の機械生命体。起動時期こそ最近だが、製造された時期は遥か昔のようだ。一度廃棄されており、廃棄区画から抜け出すのには数年を要した。"
en: A working mechanical life form from outer space. It seems to have been manufactured a long time ago although it started up recently. Once discarded it took several years to get out of the disposal area.
en_grezzo: "A working mechanical life form from outer space. It seems to have been manufactured a long time ago although it started up recently. Once discarded it took several years to get out of the disposal area."
it: Una forma di vita meccanica venuta dallo spazio, costruita per lavorare. Si è accesa da poco, ma pare che l'abbiano fabbricata in tempi remotissimi. Una volta l'avevano buttata via, e per uscire dal settore dei rifiuti ci ha messo qualche anno.

jp: 化身の黒猫のモデルとなった、不幸を司る女神。幸運の女神と神々の大戦時に戦い、激戦の果てにその力の大半を相殺されたが、勝ったのは自分だと信じてやまない。
jp_grezzo: "化身の黒猫のモデルとなった、不幸を司る女神。幸運の女神と神々の大戦時に戦い、激戦の果てにその力の大半を相殺されたが、勝ったのは自分だと信じてやまない。"
en: The goddess of misfortune who is the model for the Black Cat. She fought during the Great War among the gods and the Goddess of Fortune and though the fierce battle stripped most of her power she still believes she was the one who won.
en_grezzo: "The goddess of misfortune who is the model for the Black Cat. She fought during the Great War among the gods and the Goddess of Fortune and though the fierce battle stripped most of her power she still believes she was the one who won."
it: La dea che ha in mano la sfortuna, e su di lei è modellato il gatto nero delle Incarnazioni. Nella grande guerra fra gli dei si batté contro la dea della fortuna, e in capo a uno scontro durissimo si vide annullare quasi tutto il proprio potere: ma che ad averla vinta sia stata lei, non c'è verso di levarglielo dalla testa.

jp: 元は天使だったのだが、風の女神に服従と忠誠を誓い、力を分け与えられて神となった。日焼けや砂まみれになるのを嫌がって、ずっと引きこもっている。黒天使のモデルとなった。
jp_grezzo: "元は天使だったのだが、風の女神に服従と忠誠を誓い、力を分け与えられて神となった。日焼けや砂まみれになるのを嫌がって、ずっと引きこもっている。黒天使のモデルとなった。"
en: Originally an angel she swore obedience and allegiance to the goddess of the wind and was given power to become a deity. She doesn't want to get sunburned or covered in sand so she stays withdrawn all the time. She became the model for the Black Angel.
en_grezzo: "Originally an angel she swore obedience and allegiance to the goddess of the wind and was given power to become a deity. She doesn't want to get sunburned or covered in sand so she stays withdrawn all the time. She became the model for the Black Angel."
it: In origine era un angelo, poi giurò obbedienza e fedeltà alla dea del vento, ne ebbe in dono una parte del potere e divenne dea. Detesta scottarsi al sole e riempirsi di sabbia, e per questo se ne sta sempre chiusa in casa. Su di lei è modellato l'angelo nero.

jp: 溶岩でできたゴーレム。魔力によって膨大な熱量を維持している。高熱攻撃はエネルギーの消費が大きいため使いたがらない。内部に溜まっている水蒸気やガスを爆発させての攻撃が得意。
jp_grezzo: "溶岩でできたゴーレム。魔力によって膨大な熱量を維持している。高熱攻撃はエネルギーの消費が大きいため使いたがらない。内部に溜まっている水蒸気やガスを爆発させての攻撃が得意。"
en: A golem made of lava. It maintains an enormous amount of heat through its magic. They don't want to use high heat attacks because they consume a lot of energy. It is good at attacking by exploding steam and gas inside.
en_grezzo: "A golem made of lava. It maintains an enormous amount of heat through its magic. They don't want to use high heat attacks because they consume a lot of energy. It is good at attacking by exploding steam and gas inside."
it: Un golem fatto di lava. Il calore immenso che si porta dentro se lo mantiene con il potere magico. Gli attacchi ad alta temperatura consumano troppa energia, e infatti non li usa volentieri. Preferisce far esplodere il vapore e i gas che gli si accumulano dentro.

jp: 収穫の神の生命輪廻を司る側面より生まれた中級神。生命の存在記録を管理する者で、定められていない死を迎えた者を蘇生して送り返している。妖精さんのモデルともなった。
jp_grezzo: "収穫の神の生命輪廻を司る側面より生まれた中級神。生命の存在記録を管理する者で、定められていない死を迎えた者を蘇生して送り返している。妖精さんのモデルともなった。"
en: A mid-level deity born from the aspect of the god of harvest who presides over the cycle of life and samsara. He is the custodian of the record of the existence of life resuscitating and sending back those who have met an unspecified death. He also became a model for the fairies.
en_grezzo: "A mid-level deity born from the aspect of the god of harvest who presides over the cycle of life and samsara. He is the custodian of the record of the existence of life resuscitating and sending back those who have met an unspecified death. He also became a model for the fairies."
it: Una divinità di medio rango nata dal lato del dio del raccolto che governa il ciclo delle vite. Tiene il registro di ogni esistenza, e chi incontra una morte che non era scritta lo riporta in vita e lo rimanda indietro. Su di lui è modellata anche la fatina.
